subject: config: enable LEDS_CLASS_MULTICOLOR for hid-playstation and hid-logitech (#93)
author: Michael Ferguson

upstream.vanilla_file_line: drivers/leds/Kconfig:39 (LEDS_CLASS_MULTICOLOR), drivers/hid/Kconfig:639-643 (HID_LOGITECH), drivers/hid/Kconfig:648-652 (HID_LOGITECH_DJ), drivers/hid/Kconfig:661 (HID_LOGITECH_HIDPP), drivers/hid/Kconfig:673 (LOGITECH_FF), :687 (LOGIRUMBLEPAD2_FF), :697 (LOGIG940_FF), :705-709 (LOGIWHEELS_FF), :991-994 (HID_PLAYSTATION), :1001 (PLAYSTATION_FF) -- all in linux-6.18.52
upstream.vanilla_quote:
config HID_LOGITECH
	tristate "Logitech devices"
	depends on USB_HID
	depends on LEDS_CLASS
	depends on LEDS_CLASS_MULTICOLOR
	default !EXPERT
---
config HID_PLAYSTATION
	tristate "PlayStation HID Driver"
	depends on LEDS_CLASS_MULTICOLOR
	select CRC32
	select POWER_SUPPLY
---
config LOGIWHEELS_FF
	bool "Logitech wheels configuration and force feedback support"
	depends on HID_LOGITECH
	select INPUT_FF_MEMLESS
	default LOGITECH_FF

provenance_doc_ref: none -- postdates docs/patch-provenance.md's baseline. Our side of this is docs/kernel-config-deltas.md row D9 and docs/verification/stock-reconciliation-20260907/.

impact.effect_if_absent: On STOCK (which is what this commit changes), absent: HID_PLAYSTATION and HID_LOGITECH are unbuildable because their `depends on LEDS_CLASS_MULTICOLOR` is unmet, so DualShock 4 and DualSense fall back to hid-generic -- no rumble, no lightbar, no player LED, no mute button -- and Logitech Unifying/HID++ receivers and wheel force feedback disappear entirely. On OUR image: no effect, the symbols are already set (see superseded_by); this record changes nothing about what we ship.
affected_hardware: Logitech Unifying / HID++ receivers and keyboards
Logitech G25/G27/G29/Driving Force wheels, G940 flight system, RumblePad 2

userspace_coupling.interface: FF_RUMBLE force feedback over /dev/input/eventX (EVIOCRMFF / ff_effect), and the multicolor LED sysfs class under /sys/class/leds that hid-playstation's lightbar and player-id LEDs register into
userspace_coupling.main_mister_ref: input.cpp:4871 (`ioctl(fd, EVIOCRMFF, ...)`), :4881 (`fef->type = FF_RUMBLE;`), :5228 (`test_bit(FF_RUMBLE, ff_features)`), :1503 (`int has_rumble;`) -- the same citations record bbeff2c30…json re-derived for the Logitech FF symbols; unchanged here.

forward_port.effort: none -- kconfig only, and already resolved in our tree

superseded_by: board/mister/common/linux-mister.fragment:481-482,496 (the shared profile fragment carries the same three)

notes:
DIRECTION IS INVERTED, and that is the headline for this whole increment. Every fork-sync record before 2026-09-12 describes a commit that landed on the fork and had to be pulled IN. This commit went the other way: it was authored in THIS repo, sent upstream as MiSTer-devel/Linux-Kernel_MiSTer PR #93 from mcfbytes:config-leds-multicolor, and merged 2026-09-12T09:54:40Z. docs/kernel-recon/fork-sync-2026-09/upstream-candidates/README.md records the send. scripts/check-fork-sync.sh cannot tell the two directions apart -- it only knows the fork moved -- so an outbound commit still arrives in the backport queue and still needs a record. This record IS the evidence of direction, and the disposition question ('does our image have this?') is answered by construction rather than by a port.

WHAT IT FIXES UPSTREAM, and why we found it: stock's 6.18 regeneration lost HID_PLAYSTATION and the whole HID_LOGITECH family because both gained `depends on LEDS_CLASS_MULTICOLOR` (HID_PLAYSTATION since 5.16, HID_LOGITECH since 6.15) and that symbol was left unset, so the dependency silently dropped the drivers out of the defconfig. Found by the 2026-09-07 stock-config reconciliation (docs/verification/stock-reconciliation-20260907/, docs/kernel-config-deltas.md row D9), not by a build failure -- a Kconfig dependency going unmet is the loudest-possible-silent failure: the defconfig regenerates cleanly, the kernel builds, and the driver is simply gone.

OUR SIDE, re-derived rather than assumed: all eight symbols are set explicitly in board/mister/de10nano/linux.config (lines quoted in superseded_by). Two of the ten symbols the fork commit sets are NOT in our file and do not need to be -- HID_LOGITECH_HIDPP arrives by `select` from HID_LOGITECH_DJ=y, and LOGIWHEELS_FF by `default LOGITECH_FF` (both quoted from linux-6.18.52's drivers/hid/Kconfig above). That is the same default-resolution mechanism record d788e7ab9…json verified in a real resolved .config, so this is not a new claim, just the same one re-grounded on the currently pinned kernel.

DISPOSITION CHOICE: dropped-deliberate, not carried -- 'carried' strictly means a 00xx-*.patch exists in linux-patches/ (worker-instructions, pilot lessons), and a kconfig commit whose symbols our config already sets is the dropped-deliberate/superseded_by shape used for Q1 (aec7dc3aa, TUN) and Q2 (33a0521fd, RTW88_8821AU) in the 2026-09 increment. Nothing to port.
